questions.text: Is climate action the core purpose or goal of the policy?
questions.answer: The policy clearly identifies climate action as its core purpose. The policy's objectives are to achieve zero-net emissions across the entire Yarra community by 2030, and to enable the community to take effective climate action. The policy outlines a comprehensive plan to mobilize the community, accelerate renewable energy, create a climate-adapted city, transition to zero emissions transport, and move towards zero waste. It includes specific actions such as delivering a new climate program, committing substantial grant funds to stimulate community-driven climate action, and upgrading homes to be more energy efficient and climate resilient. The policy also aims to engage 10,000 people in Yarra to take action on the climate emergency by 2024. Therefore, it is evident that climate action is the core purpose of this policy.

questions.answer: The documents indeed refer to specific regional associations, alliances, or other partnerships related to climate.
